dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL or similar open-source/PC COBOL; uses LINE SEQUENTIAL, GOBACK, DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE, and fixed format. No mainframe-specific features like COMP-3 or JCL references.

purpose.domain_detail: Shop sales reporting — reads shop receipts data file and produces a formatted sales report with per-shop totals
purpose.summary: SALE-REPORT reads a sequential input file of shop receipts (header and detail records) and writes a formatted report showing item ID, quantity sold, cost per item, and total quantity/cost per shop. It processes multiple shops in a single pass, accumulating totals per shop group.

notable_features: 88-level condition names used for file status checks
DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE for error messages
GOBACK instead of STOP RUN for normal termination
Numeric editing with $$$9.99 and ZZZZ9 picture clauses
Dual-buffer input (INPUT-HEAD-BUFFER and INPUT-DETAIL-BUFFER redefine same FD implicitly)
No COPY statements, no CALL statements, no SQL or CICS
verdict.notes: The program uses a Thai author name (VIRAPAT) suggesting a student or training context. The variable name WS-CACULATION contains a spelling error ('CACULATION' instead of 'CALCULATION'). The two 01-level records under the same FD (INPUT-HEAD-BUFFER and INPUT-DETAIL-BUFFER) share the same buffer implicitly. No COMP-3 usage and no mainframe-specific extensions; most consistent with GnuCOBOL or similar PC/open-source COBOL environment.
